claim_verbatim: Indonesia private health insurance market is approximately $2.93B with BPJS commanding ~71.6% share of total health insurance.

new_sources.key_data: OJK Statistik Perasuransian 2023 — private health insurance (asuransi kesehatan) premiums: Rp 26.26 trillion (~$1.69B at 15,500 IDR/USD), not $2.93B. Policies issued: 29.29 million in 2023.
ANTARA quoting OJK: private health premi Rp 26.26T in 2023, rose 43.01% to Rp 40.19T in 2024; claim ratio 97.52% in 2023. BPJS figures not included in private premi.
BPJS Kesehatan iuran 2023: Rp 151.4 trillion (~$9.77B). Combined private + BPJS total = Rp 177.66T (~$11.46B). BPJS actual share = 85.2%, not 71.6%.
BPJS Kesehatan received Rp 151.4 trillion iuran in 2023 (5.1% YoY growth). Confirms OJK-derived BPJS share of 85.2% of combined market.

private_market_size.discrepancy: Claim overstates private market by ~1.7x. Mordor Intelligence likely includes group life health riders or uses a broader definition.

bpjs_share.ojk_plus_bpjs_primary_data_says: 85.2% (Rp 151.4T BPJS vs Rp 26.26T private = Rp 177.66T combined)
bpjs_share.discrepancy: Claim understates BPJS dominance by ~13.6 percentage points. The 71.6% figure appears unsourced or uses a different denominator (total national health expenditure ~Rp 614T, where BPJS = 24.6%).

suggested_revision: Replace with: 'Indonesia private commercial health insurance premiums totalled Rp 26.26 trillion (~$1.7B) in 2023, per OJK Statistik Perasuransian 2023. BPJS Kesehatan collected Rp 151.4 trillion in iuran — approximately 85% of the combined formal health insurance pool. The $2.93B figure cited by Mordor Intelligence appears to use a broader definition (possibly including group life health riders) and the 71.6% BPJS share is inconsistent with OJK primary data.' [ASSUMED-N on $2.93B figure — requires Mordor methodology disclosure]
reasoning: OJK Statistik Perasuransian 2023 (primary regulator) and BPJS annual financials both contradict the claim. Private health premi is ~$1.7B not $2.93B, and BPJS commands ~85% of the formal insurance pool not 71.6%. The Mordor Intelligence $2.93B figure is an unvalidatable aggregator estimate with an opaque methodology.
